name: Panama Canal Menu: Warm Cheddar & Bacon Tartlet and Cream of Cauliflower Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Panama Canal Dinner Menu
whyItWorks: Aged cheddar and bacon tartlet is low-fiber if you skip the sweet onion sauce; cauliflower soup is blended smooth but high in mannitol FODMAPs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the Warm Cheddar & Bacon Tartlet without the sweet onion sauce; if ordering the Cream of Cauliflower Soup in remission, ask to hold the toasted almond garnish.
watchOuts: Cauliflower mannitol and toasted almonds in soup
Skip the Cold Avocado Corn Soup during flares
